themes.theme: How do I get an AI assistant to write in my own voice

evidence.paraphrase: Everything the assistant produces reads like a press release and the team can tell it was not written by them.
They want the same voice in a short email, a post and a board deck without rewriting every draft.

themes.theme: AI output sounds generic and needs heavy editing

evidence.paraphrase: Pasting old posts into a custom GPT helped for a few replies, then the output drifted back to generic.

themes.theme: Should I build my own AI skill or buy one

evidence.paraphrase: They keep hitting the question of whether to build a personal skill themselves or buy something.

themes.theme: How much of my own writing does the model need to learn my style

evidence.paraphrase: They have years of emails, decks and a newsletter and do not know how much of it the model needs.

themes.theme: Keeping a consistent voice across email, posts and decks

evidence.paraphrase: Consistent means one voice across a two-line email, a LinkedIn post and a board deck.
